record.question: In the context of Indian elections, which use the First Past The Post (FPTP) system for both Lok Sabha and State Assembly Elections, which of the following statements gives the most accurate description of this electoral system?
options: The candidate who secures more than 50% of the total votes in a constituency is declared the winner
The candidate who receives the highest number of votes in a constituency is declared the winner, regardless of whether they secure more than 50% of the total votes or not
The candidate who receives the most first-preference rankings from voters is declared the winner
The candidate is finally elected based on the proportion of total votes received by their party across the country
